title: Page 10
content_zh:
他深深凝望着。「你这样是存心想让我心猿意马，无心做事吗？」

迎上他那闪动炽热光芒的幽深黑眸，她意识到他的意思，立刻羞红了脸。

「现在乖乖做事去吧。」她勾着他脖子，低头将嘴巴凑到他耳边，「那事……晩上再说。」

在靳雪鸿热情又带着点疯狂的爱怜及亲吻之下，陆诗妍身体里的那朵花儿也缓缓绽放。

她在他温暖的身下呢喃，在他湿润的唇片下瘫软虚乏，也在他犹如膜拜般的抚摸下疯狂。

他轻轻吮吻着她敏感又娇弱的蓓蕾，温热而厚实的掌心包覆着她的浑圆，她光洁白晳又娇嫩的身子，一览无遗地在他眼前呈现。

在他的修长的手指撩拨下，她的身躯一阵的火热，也一阵阵的紧缩痉挛，一股春泉自她体内涌出，仿佛在迎接着他的顾盼。

他俯着身，继续着那令人疯狂的撩弄。「早上不是说得那么轻松吗？现在又说不要？」看着在自己身下，全身都因难耐的兴奋而潮红着的她，他狡黠一笑。

「你……使坏……」她娇喘着道。

他声线低沉地道：「还能更坏。」说罢，他轻轻托起她虚软无力的腰肢，温柔却又霸道地向她逼近。

她陷入了一种如梦似幻的混沌中，感受着前所未有的快意。

她只记得自己不断地呼唤着他的名字，却不记得这火热的一切是何时结束、如何结束。

她知道，她已失去了意识，而当她的幽幽转醒，发现靳雪鸿已不在身边。

她一怔，起身掀起袖子，只见他的位置上摆放着一只精致的黄花梨木雕箱子。

「咦？」她先是一愣，然后好奇又困惑地开，猛地瞪大眼睛。「天呐！」

是蟠龙转心瓶，就跟她当年打碎的那只一模一样。

是靳雪鸿为她寻来的吧？老天，他是怎么办到的？他实在太宠她了！

「雪鸿？」她喊着他，但没人回应。

她等不及地捞起袍子穿上，兴奋地抱着那木盒，打着赤脚就往房门口跑。才刚到门前，靳雪鸿一把将她拦腰抱起，她吓了一跳，但旋即兴奋地笑视着他。

「雪鸿，是转心瓶！是转心瓶！」

看她兴奋得衣衫不整又赤着脚就想跑出房外，他忍不住皱起眉头。「天未亮，外面冷，地上又冰，你会冻着的。」他一边说教，一边将她抱回床上。

陆诗妍坐在床上，怀里紧紧抱着那木盒，高兴得眼眶泛沮。「雪鸿，你是如何找到这转心瓶的？」

靳雪鸿在床沿坐了下来，轻柔的拉过她有点凉的两只脚丫子，揉着暖着。「我找到靡实的后人了。」

闻言，她一惊，「是什么时候的事？」

「还记得先前我出门一个月，说要去办货吗？」他一笑。

她点点头。「记得，你说要去南方。」

「我便是打听到他隐居在南方一个名叫湖东的小山城，才会亲自前往请他割爱，将转心瓶让给我。」

陆诗妍皱皱眉头。「靡实的后人肯吗？」

「一开始当然不肯，我都差点要跟他下跪了。」靳雪鸿蹙眉苦笑。

「是吗？」她知道得来不易，想必他费了一番功夫。「那你后来是如何说服他的？」

他深情地望着她。「我告诉他，为了让我心爱女人那双像是夜空里最闪亮的两颗星星似的眼睛再亮起来，我无论如何都要得到这只转心瓶。」

「雪鸿……」

他温柔地抚摸着她的脸颊，轻柔地挡去她因激动及感动而流下的泪。「为了这两颗星辰，我什么都愿意做。」

知道他如此疼她、宠她，她感动不已，将木盒搁在一旁，一把勾抱住他的脖子，胡乱的亲着他的脸，一边欣喜的道：「雪鸿，谢谢你，谢谢你，我爱你。」

靳雪鸿腾出手将木盒妥当的放在一旁。「小心点，这已经是世上唯一的蟠龙转心瓶了。」

她看着他，尴尬地一笑。

「再弄破，你夫君我纵有通天本领，也弄不出第三只给你了。」

「嗯。」她用力地点点头。「我知道，我明白，我会很小心的。」

靳雪鸿将她紧紧地抱在怀中，大手轻轻的往她胸口揉去，两只眼睛仿佛窜着烈火般的注视着她。

「夫君我如此用心，你是不是该有点回报？」

她怯怯地睇着他。「你……你想要什么回报？」

「离天亮还有一个时辰，不如……」他话未说完，已卸下她的袍子。

她下意识的用手挡着裸胸，满脸潮红。「只有一个时辰，不够你……」

「够了。」他不让她有机会拒绝，一把将她擒入暖帐，恩爱缠绵。

【全书完】

注：相关书籍推荐：

1、月亮升起时之一《村花有财气》；

2、月亮升起时之二《密探有点忙》；

3、月亮升起时之三《镇店女朝奉》。

祈愿 春野樱

很多人应该都会在新春期间到庙宇走走吧？也许是到外地，也或许是就近，总之到了新年期间，总能见到各大庙宇挤满参拜人潮。

我没有虔诚的信仰，但还是会在大年初一早上到庙里绕一圈，换个好运气，且不论到了哪里，只要看见大小寺庙，我一定会合掌跟神明们打个招呼。

前不久骑车行经一八二县道，意外发现路边的路标写着「内门紫竹林」，突然想起在母亲生前曾与她一起到这儿参拜观世音菩萨，还记得那年我只有二十岁出头吧，不知为何一见到紫竹林的观音嬷就一直掉眼泪，之后我不曾再回到此地，而母亲也早已离世十数年。

于是，我回头循着路进了紫竹林寺，发现二十几年过去，景物似乎也没多大变化。

进到寺里，拿起香，见着观音嬷，不知怎地眼泪又止不住，心里明明没什么太多的情绪，但眼泪就是不自觉地流下。

(哈哈，听人家说这是因为找到「主人」了。)

敬香完毕，想说最近刚换机车，顺便跟观音嬷求个平安符系在车上，没想到掷了几次茭都是阴茭，旁边的友人献策说：「你问问观音嬷，是不是觉得你已经有了，不需要。」

我照着朋友说法问一次，一掷，就是圣茭。

我沮丧地起身，将茭杯交给朋友，朋友一掷，就是圣茭，我不甘心，又一次跪下跟观音嬷求，可祂还是没给我。

「观音嬷，拜扦啦，给我一个。」我求道。

「你再掷下去，观音嬷都要生气了。」朋友在一旁笑着劝我。

于是乎，我放弃了。去跟庙里志工拿平安符时，把刚才的情况说了一遍，志工大姊忍不住笑了起来。

「观音嬷一定是帮你监定过，确认你不需要，才会不给你。」她安慰我说。

我想想也是，我车上有保安宫的几位千岁爷开台天后宫的妈祖娘娘，可能太拥挤了吧？

我不是个迷信或是虔诚的人，对于神佛，我就是觉得祂们是可敬又厉害的长辈，平常我不会特地去麻烦祂们，但只要经过就会去打声招呼，顺道祈求祂们能庇佑我、家人及亲服好友都能出入平安，就学中的都能Allpass，工作的都能赚钱，遇困难的都能圆满，当然也会祈求台湾能国泰民安，风调雨顺。

我的愿望很小、很简单，因为平安即是福，至于那些发大财的愿望，我是从来不为难诸神。（哈哈）

人生在世，有太多我们无法解决，甚至是理解的烦恼及困难，因为茫然失措、因为走投无路、因为绝望……所以，我们将希望寄托在神明身上，祈求无所不能的祂们能为我们指点迷津，开一扇窗。

He stared deeply."Are you doing this deliberately to make me distracted and unmotivated to do anything?"

Facing his deep black eyes flashing with fiery light, she realized what he meant and immediately blushed.

"Now go and do your work." She hooked her arms around his neck, lowered her head and put her mouth to his ear, "We'll talk about that later..."

Under Jin Xuehong's passionate and slightly crazy love and kiss, the flower in Lu Shiyan's body slowly bloomed.

She murmured under his warm body, became limp and weak under his moist lips, and went crazy under his worship-like touch.

He gently sucked and kissed her sensitive and delicate bud, and his warm and thick palms covered her round body. Her smooth, white and delicate body was clearly visible to him.

Under his slender fingers, her body felt hot, contracting and convulsing, and a stream of spring gushes out of her body, as if to welcome his gaze.

He leaned over and continued the crazy teasing."Didn't you say it so easily in the morning? Now you say no?" Looking at her body underneath him, her whole body flushed with unbearable excitement, he smiled slyly.

"You... are causing trouble..." she gasped.

He said in a low voice: "It can be worse." After that, he gently held up her weak waist and approached her gently but domineeringly.

She fell into a dreamlike chaos, feeling unprecedented pleasure.

She only remembered that she kept calling his name, but she couldn't remember when and how this fiery thing ended.

She knew that she had lost consciousness, and when she woke up, she found that Jin Xuehong was no longer around.

She was startled, then stood up and lifted up her sleeves, and saw an exquisite huanghuali wood-carved box placed in his place.

"Huh?" She was stunned for a moment, then opened her eyes in curiosity and confusion."Oh my God!"

It's the Panlong Heart-turning Bottle, exactly like the one she broke back then.

Was it Jin Xuehong who found it for her?God, how did he do it?He dotes on her so much!

"Xue Hong?" She called to him, but no one responded.

She couldn't wait to pick up the robe and put it on. She excitedly hugged the wooden box and ran to the door of the room with bare feet.Just when they arrived at the door, Jin Xuehong picked her up by the waist. She was startled, but then she smiled excitedly at him.

"Xuehong, it's a heart-changing bottle! It's a heart-changing bottle!"

Seeing that she was so excited that she wanted to run out of the room disheveled and barefoot, he couldn't help but frown."It's not yet dawn, it's cold outside, and the ground is icy. You'll freeze." He preached while carrying her back to the bed.

Lu Shiyan sat on the bed, holding the wooden box tightly in her arms, her eyes filled with joy."Xuehong, how did you find this heart-changing bottle?"

Jin Xuehong sat down on the edge of the bed, gently pulled her cold feet and rubbed them to warm them."I found Mi Shi's descendant."

Hearing this, she was shocked, "When did it happen?"

"Remember when I was away for a month and said I had to do some shopping?" He smiled.

She nodded."Remember, you said you were going to the south."

"It was only after I found out that he was living in seclusion in a small mountain town in the south called Hudong that I personally went to ask him to part ways with me and give me the heart-turning bottle."

Lu Shiyan frowned."Are Mishi's descendants willing?"

"Of course I refused at first. I almost knelt down with him." Jin Xuehong frowned and smiled bitterly.

"Really?" She knew it was not easy to get, and he must have spent a lot of effort."Then how did you convince him later?"

He looked at her lovingly."I told him that in order to make my beloved woman's eyes shine again like the two brightest stars in the night sky, I must get this heart-turning bottle at any cost."

"Xue Hong..."

He gently stroked her cheek, gently blocking the tears she shed due to excitement and emotion."For these two stars, I will do anything."

Knowing that he loved her and doted on her so much, she was moved. She put the wooden box aside, hugged his neck, kissed his face randomly, and said happily: "Xuehong, thank you, thank you, I love you."

Jin Xuehong freed up his hand and put the wooden box aside safely."Be careful, this is the only Panlong Heart-turning Bottle in the world."

She looked at him and smiled awkwardly.

"If you break it again, your husband, even if I have extraordinary abilities, I won't be able to get a third one for you."

"Yeah." She nodded vigorously."I know, I understand, I will be very careful."

Jin Xuehong held her tightly in his arms, gently rubbed her chest with his big hands, and stared at her like fire with his eyes.

"Husband, I work so hard, shouldn't you repay me?"

She looked at him timidly."You...what do you want in return?"

"There's still an hour before dawn, why not..." Before he could finish his words, he had already taken off her robe.

She subconsciously covered her naked breasts with her hands, her face flushed."Only one hour is not enough for you..."

"That's enough." He didn't let her have the chance to refuse, and grabbed her into the warm tent, loving her.

【Complete book】

Note: Recommended related books:

1. When the Moon Rises - "Village Flowers Have Wealth";

2. When the Moon Rises Part 2 "The Secret Agent is a Little Busy";

3. When the Moon Rises Part 3 "The Female Court of the Zhendian".

Prayer Haruno Sakura

Many people should go to temples during the Chinese New Year, right?Maybe it's out of town, or maybe it's nearby. In short, during the New Year period, you can always see major temples crowded with worshipers.

I don’t have any religious beliefs, but I will still go around the temple on the morning of New Year’s Day for good luck. No matter where I go, whenever I see a temple, big or small, I will definitely put my hands together and say hello to the gods.

Not long ago, I was riding my bicycle on County Road 182, and I accidentally noticed a sign on the side of the road that read "Inner Gate Purple Bamboo Forest." I suddenly remembered that my mother and I had gone here to worship Guanyin Bodhisattva before she was alive. I still remember that I was only in my early twenties at that time. For some reason, I kept crying when I saw Avalokitesvara in the Purple Bamboo Forest. I have never returned to this place since, and my mother has passed away more than ten years ago.

So, I turned back and followed the road into Zizhulin Temple, and found that the scenery did not seem to have changed much in the past twenty years.

When I entered the temple, picked up the incense and saw Avalokitesvara, I couldn't stop crying for some reason. I obviously didn't have much emotion in my heart, but the tears just flowed down unconsciously.

(Haha, I heard people say it’s because they found the “owner”.)

After offering the incense, I wanted to say that I just changed my motorcycle recently, so I asked Grandma Guanyin for a peace charm to tie on the car. I didn’t expect that after I threw the wild rice plants several times, they all turned out to be Yin. A friend next to me offered advice and said, “Ask Grandma Guanyin if you think you already have it and don’t need it.”

I followed my friend's instructions and asked once, and once I threw it, it was holy water bamboo shoots.

I stood up in frustration and handed the rice cup to my friend. When my friend threw it, it was the Holy Wild Rice. I was unwilling to accept it and knelt down to beg Avalokitesvara again, but she still didn’t give it to me.

"Aunt Guanyin, please give me one." I begged.

"If you throw it again, Avalokitesvara will be angry." My friend advised me with a smile.

Ever since, I gave up.When I went to get the peace charm from the volunteers at the temple, I told her what had just happened, and the volunteer elder sister couldn't help but laugh.

"Ms. Guanyin must have checked it for you and confirmed that you don't need it, so she wouldn't give it to you." She comforted me.

I think about it, there are several thousand-year-old masters from Baoan Palace in my car, and Mazu and Empress from Tianhou Temple. Maybe it is too crowded?

I am not a superstitious or devout person. When it comes to gods and Buddhas, I just think that they are respectable and powerful elders. Normally, I would not go out of my way to trouble them, but I would say hello whenever I pass by them. I also pray that they can protect me, my family, and my close friends, so that I can come and go safely, that everyone in school can have All Pass, that everyone who works can make money, and everyone who encounters difficulties can be successful. Of course, I also pray that Taiwan will be peaceful and peaceful, and that the weather will be smooth.

My wishes are small and simple, because peace is blessing. As for those wishes of making a fortune, I never embarrass the gods.(haha)

In life, there are too many troubles and difficulties that we cannot solve or even understand, because we are at a loss, because we have no way out, because we are desperate... Therefore, we place our hope on the gods and pray that the omnipotent ones can guide us and open a window.
